# Awesome Privacy snapshot

A copy of [awesome-privacy.yml](https://github.com/Lissy93/awesome-privacy/blob/main/awesome-privacy.yml)
from [Awesome Privacy](https://github.com/Lissy93/awesome-privacy) by Alicia Sykes and contributors,
released under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

`npm run import` downloads the latest version and refreshes this copy. When the download fails,
is blocked, or returns something that is not a valid Awesome Privacy file, the import uses this
copy instead and nothing breaks. Entries already imported live in `ratings/` and are never removed
by the import, so the data stays here even if Awesome Privacy goes away.

`meta.json` records where and when the copy was last refreshed.
